sources.query: SELECT INTEGRATION_ID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, REQUESTOR_ID, SUPPLIER_ID, SUPPLIER_ACCOUNT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLANT_LOC_ID, INVENTORY_ORG_ID, RCPT_LOC_ID, RQSTN_ORG_ID, OPERATING_UNIT_ORG_ID, APPROVAL_STATUS_ID, CYCLE_STATUS_ID, LINE_TYPE_ID, REQUESTED_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, LINE_AMT, CANCELLED_LINE_QTY, CANCELLED_LINE_AMT, UOM_CODE, UNIT_STD_COST, STD_COST_AMT, NEEDED_BY_DT, SUBMITTED_ON_DT, APPROVED_ON_DT, PO_APPROVED_ON_DT, PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT, PO_CREATION_METHOD_ID, PO_REVISIONS, CREATED_ON_DT, DOC_CURR_CODE, LOC_CURR_CODE, LOC_EXCH_RATE_TYPE, LOC_EXCHANGE_RATE, DELETE_FLG, URGENT_FLAG, PURCH_RQSTN_NUM, PURCH_RQSTN_ITEM, LINE_TEXT FROM W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS

-- NOTE: $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] is a DataOps dataflow parameter substituting for the Informatica mapping variable $$DATASOURCE_NUM_ID; it is currently a placeholder (0) and MUST be corrected to the real value before results are trusted.
-- NOTE: the mapping-level SQ_BCI_PURCH_RQLNS source-qualifier SQL also applies an incremental row-selection UNION (HEADERS_ALL/LINES_ALL/LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= $$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE) that only controls WHEN a row is captured in a given incremental run, not whether it permanently belongs in the target. This steady-state comparison intentionally omits that time-gated clause.
-- Independently derived from the OLTP source tables plus OBIA reference/lookup tables (W_STANDARD_COST_G, W_ORA_INT_ORG_D_TMP, W_LOC_CURR_CODE_TMP, W_EXCH_RATE_G, MTL_UNITS_OF_MEASURE), reconstructing the business rules that live in the mapping's expressions/mapplets (Exp_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS_Integration_Id, mplt_SA_ORA_PurchaseRequisitionLinesFact, MPLT_CURCY_CONVERSION_RATES_All) -- NOT copied from the SQ_BCI_PURCH_RQLNS SQL override text, which only has the raw joins and none of these downstream rules.
-- SCOPE NOTE: XACT_TYPE_ID, MFG_PROD_ID, SUPPLIER_PROD_ID2-4, FULFILLMENT_STATUS_ID, TENANT_ID are intentionally excluded -- their exact upstream source field could not be confidently traced through the mapplet port renames and are not guessed here.
-- ASSUMPTION: LOC_EXCHANGE_RATE's GLOBAL1/2/3 currency-code fallback tier (via GET_GLOBAL_CURR_CODES_AND_RATE_TYPES/W_GLOBAL_CURR_G) is collapsed to the DOC->LOC leg only (the leg actually stored on this target); W_GLOBAL_CURR_G is assumed single-tenant (TENANT_ID condition omitted) -- verify against real data.
WITH CURRENCY_LST AS (
  SELECT NVL(FSP.ORG_ID, -99) AS ORG_ID, GSB.CURRENCY_CODE
  FROM FINANCIALS_SYSTEM_PARAMS_ALL FSP
  JOIN GL_SETS_OF_BOOKS GSB ON FSP.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID = GSB.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
),
PR_DATE AS (
  SELECT OBJECT_ID,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ACTION_CODE = 'APPROVE' THEN LAST_UPDATE_DATE END) AS LAST_APPROVED_DATE,
         MIN(CASE WHEN ACTION_CODE IN ('SUBMIT','IMPORT') THEN LAST_UPDATE_DATE END) AS LAST_SUBMIT_DATE
  FROM PO_ACTION_HISTORY
  WHERE OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQUISITION' AND ACTION_CODE IN ('APPROVE','SUBMIT','IMPORT')
  GROUP BY OBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(PRL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID) AS INTEGRATION_ID,
  $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
  TO_CHAR(PRL.TO_PERSON_ID) AS REQUESTOR_ID,
  TO_CHAR(PRL.VENDOR_ID) AS SUPPLIER_ID,
  TO_CHAR(PRL.VENDOR_SITE_ID) AS SUPPLIER_ACCOUNT_ID,
  CASE WHEN PRL.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'NONINVENTORY~'||TO_CHAR(PRL.CATEGORY_ID) ELSE TO_CHAR(PRL.ITEM_ID) END AS PRODUCT_ID,
  'PLANT~'||TO_CHAR(PRL.DESTINATION_ORGANIZATION_ID) AS PLANT_LOC_ID,
  TO_CHAR(PRL.DESTINATION_ORGANIZATION_ID) AS INVENTORY_ORG_ID,
  'RECIPIENT_LOC~'||TO_CHAR(PRL.DELIVER_TO_LOCATION_ID) AS RCPT_LOC_ID,
  TO_CHAR(PRL.ORG_ID) AS RQSTN_ORG_ID,
  TO_CHAR(PRL.ORG_ID) AS OPERATING_UNIT_ORG_ID,
  CASE WHEN PRH.AUTHORIZATION_STATUS IS NULL AND PRL.CLOSED_CODE IS NULL THEN 'PURCH_APPROVE~INCOMPLETE'
       ELSE 'PURCH_APPROVE~'||LTRIM(RTRIM(PRH.AUTHORIZATION_STATUS))||'~'||LTRIM(RTRIM(PRL.CLOSED_CODE))
  END AS APPROVAL_STATUS_ID,
  CASE WHEN PRL.CLOSED_CODE IS NULL THEN 'PURCH_CYCLE~OPEN~OPEN' ELSE 'PURCH_CYCLE~'||PRL.CLOSED_CODE END AS CYCLE_STATUS_ID,
  'PO_LINE_TYPE~'||TO_CHAR(PRL.LINE_TYPE_ID) AS LINE_TYPE_ID,
  PRL.QUANTITY AS REQUESTED_QTY,
  NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE, PRL.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE,
  CASE WHEN PRL.MATCHING_BASIS = 'AMOUNT' THEN PRL.AMOUNT ELSE NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE, PRL.UNIT_PRICE) * PRL.QUANTITY END AS LINE_AMT,
  PRL.QUANTITY_CANCELLED AS CANCELLED_LINE_QTY,
  CASE WHEN PRL.MATCHING_BASIS = 'AMOUNT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE, PRL.UNIT_PRICE) * PRL.QUANTITY_CANCELLED END AS CANCELLED_LINE_AMT,
  UOM.UOM_CODE,
  SC.STD_COST AS UNIT_STD_COST,
  SC.STD_COST * PRL.QUANTITY AS STD_COST_AMT,
  NVL(PLL.PROMISED_DATE, NVL(PLL.NEED_BY_DATE, PRL.NEED_BY_DATE)) AS NEEDED_BY_DT,
  PRL.CREATION_DATE AS SUBMITTED_ON_DT,
  NVL(PRH.APPROVED_DATE, PD.LAST_APPROVED_DATE) AS APPROVED_ON_DT,
  DECODE(PLL.APPROVED_FLAG, 'Y', PLL.APPROVED_DATE, NULL) AS PO_APPROVED_ON_DT,
  DECODE(PLL.PO_RELEASE_ID, NULL, POH.SUBMIT_DATE, POR.SUBMIT_DATE) AS PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT,
  DECODE(PLL.PO_RELEASE_ID, NULL, POH.DOCUMENT_CREATION_METHOD, POR.DOCUMENT_CREATION_METHOD) AS PO_CREATION_METHOD_ID,
  DECODE(PLL.PO_RELEASE_ID, NULL, POH.REVISION_NUM, POR.REVISION_NUM) AS PO_REVISIONS,
  PRL.CREATION_DATE AS CREATED_ON_DT,
  NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_CODE, CL.CURRENCY_CODE) AS DOC_CURR_CODE,
  LCC.LOC_CURR_CODE,
  POH.RATE_TYPE AS LOC_EXCH_RATE_TYPE,
  CASE
    WHEN PRL.RATE IS NOT NULL THEN PRL.RATE
    WHEN LCC.LOC_CURR_CODE = NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_CODE, CL.CURRENCY_CODE) THEN 1.0
    WHEN NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_CODE, CL.CURRENCY_CODE) = 'STAT' THEN 1.0
    WHEN LCC.LOC_CURR_CODE IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE (SELECT ER.EXCH_RATE FROM W_EXCH_RATE_G ER
          WHERE ER.FROM_CURCY_CD = NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_CODE, CL.CURRENCY_CODE)
            AND ER.TO_CURCY_CD = LCC.LOC_CURR_CODE
            AND ER.START_DT <= PRL.CREATION_DATE AND ER.END_DT > PRL.CREATION_DATE
            AND ER.RATE_TYPE = NVL(POH.RATE_TYPE, GC.DEFAULT_LOC_RATE_TYPE)
            AND ER.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID]
          FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY)
  END AS LOC_EXCHANGE_RATE,
  CASE WHEN PRL.MODIFIED_BY_AGENT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DELETE_FLG,
  PRL.URGENT_FLAG,
  PRH.SEGMENT1 AS PURCH_RQSTN_NUM,
  PRL.LINE_NUM AS PURCH_RQSTN_ITEM,
  PRL.ITEM_DESCRIPTION AS LINE_TEXT
FROM PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRL
JOIN PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRH ON PRL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRH.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLL ON PRL.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PLL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_LINES_ALL POL ON PLL.PO_LINE_ID = POL.PO_LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_RELEASES_ALL POR ON PLL.PO_RELEASE_ID = POR.PO_RELEASE_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_HEADERS_ALL POH ON POL.PO_HEADER_ID = POH.PO_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS PDSH ON POH.STYLE_ID = PDSH.STYLE_ID
LEFT JOIN PR_DATE PD ON PRL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PD.OBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN CURRENCY_LST CL ON CL.ORG_ID = NVL(PRL.ORG_ID, -99)
LEFT JOIN MTL_UNITS_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.UNIT_OF_MEASURE = PRL.UNIT_MEAS_LOOKUP_CODE
LEFT JOIN W_ORA_INT_ORG_D_TMP ORG_D ON ORG_D.ORGANIZATION_ID = TO_CHAR(PRL.DESTINATION_ORGANIZATION_ID) AND ORG_D.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID]
LEFT JOIN W_LOC_CURR_CODE_TMP LCC ON LCC.INTEGRATION_ID = ORG_D.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID AND LCC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID]
LEFT JOIN W_STANDARD_COST_G SC ON SC.INTEGRATION_ID = (CASE WHEN PRL.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'NONINVENTORY~'||TO_CHAR(PRL.CATEGORY_ID) ELSE TO_CHAR(PRL.ITEM_ID) END) || '~' || TO_CHAR(PRL.DESTINATION_ORGANIZATION_ID)
     AND SC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID]
     AND PRL.CREATION_DATE BETWEEN SC.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND SC.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN W_GLOBAL_CURR_G GC ON GC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID]
